changes.comment: Publish takes a new file along that a link in rich text names, such as a new PDF in the shared folder, and refuses to publish the deletion of a file that rich text links to, or of an entry whose media another entry uses. A save of settings with a malformed body is refused. The list of entries no longer takes ?search=, which nothing used. classifyPath moves to @micacms/core, and exports that nothing used are removed: actorOf, adminAssetsExist, badRequest, checkChangePaths, ContentError, createMediaService, DEFAULT_BASE_URL, DEFAULT_SITE_ID, developerEnvironment, editorOf, FilesError, headRevision, headSource, inRepo, LITERAL, notFound, ReadOnlyError, requestContext, schemaStats and UnknownContentError.
